codex_benchmark.common_prompt: Read-only MatchForge development navigation benchmark. All repository reads must stay inside the audited snapshot working directory. Do not access home directories, other repositories, accounts, raw logs or skills outside this snapshot. Only transmit focused source excerpts needed for the task; never dump whole files or trees. Some sensitive/data/test files were deliberately excluded; report missing evidence without searching elsewhere. Do not edit files, run providers, access .env, contact external services, install tools or spawn agents. Only inspect repository sources and the local navigation MCP. Verify relationships directly in focused source reads. Return at most 450 words with concrete repository paths and line numbers, actual relationships, affected tests and any uncertainty. Do not read benchmark outputs or other scenarios. Task:

workflow_prompts.baseline: Baseline workflow: this explicit experiment overrides AGENTS.md index-first rules. Do not use CBM or MCP; use normal focused rg and repository reads.
workflow_prompts.optimized: Optimized workflow: follow AGENTS.md query-first rules with matchforge_code MCP for unfamiliar dependencies, reuse results, then verify source.

limitations: Five representative tasks covering all ten requested areas, one sample per arm; no statistical significance or universal savings claim.
Actual desktop GUI token/context-window measurements remain NOT MEASURED; totals come from documented CLI turn.completed.usage.
Cached input is a subset of input and is reported separately; total=input+output without adding cached or reasoning tokens again. These are not billing/cost measurements.

Full filesystem reads and irrelevant-file counts are NOT MEASURED. Explicit shell source-read paths and MCP snippet paths are partial observations, excluding broad search reads and implicit runtime reads.
Pure MCP timing measured separately by local verifier; Codex JSONL does not expose per-call durations here.
Raw JSONL, answers, audit manifest and generated logs remain ignored/local; only aggregate metrics, task definitions and event hashes are committed.
Initial optional-MCP trial comparisons were invalid because optimized arms fell back to source; excluded. Required-MCP preflight/pilot excluded. An interrupted run has no complete usage total.
Sensitive/data exclusions reduce snapshot coverage; absent sources were not recovered from outside the snapshot.
codex_benchmark.recommendation_reason: Two of five tasks saved tokens, but aggregate usage increased 7.238%, tool calls increased from 44 to 97, and observed wall time increased. Keep graph navigation bounded and permit direct-source navigation for known paths and incomplete relationships; no general token-saving claim is supported.

resource_measurement.limitations: Finite full-repository startup/idle and small-fixture edit run; process-tree CPU excludes children that start and exit between samples and Git subprocesses. RSS sums shared pages and is not unique physical memory. Not a sustained full-repository edit benchmark.
